newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan interbank rate up on commercial fund demand.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan interbank rate up on commercial fund demand.

text.p: Taiwan's interbank rate rose slightly at mid-session on Thursday due to commercial demand for liquidity ahead of the Chinese Lunar New Year on February 7, dealers said.
The overnight interbank rate was at 5.792 percent against Wednesday's 5.718 close, with commercial paper at 5.65-5.75 percent against 5.70-5.75.
Dealers expected the rates to remain at high levels before February 7.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.0975 against 6.1050. -- Rachel Lee (5080815)
